notes.title: REMEDIUM Act 2 - New Content Released Today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]the first content update of Act 2 for REMEDIUM[/b]!

Today’s content update is the first stage in the full Act 2 release, including a new location, new mutant types, boss and new story content being made available for players to experience. A further two locations, enemy types, bosses and additional story arcs will be released over the coming weeks to complete the full Act 2 launch.

[previewyoutube=bm1crfsWnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pleased to announce that [b]there will be NO price increase for REMEDIUM following today’s content update[/b]. The price will only increase when we are happy with the content and quality of the game in general and Act 2 in particular. For now, the focus is delivering the most polished and content-complete version of the game during its Steam Early Access phase.  

Since the launch of Act 1, we’ve been busy gathering your feedback and introducing many quality-of-life improvements and new features, many of which were requested by players already active on the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include the balancing of battles to make weak enemies more dynamic, a reworked dash movement, new enemy spawn mechanics, improved VFX, blood effects and HUD, as well as many other cosmetic enhancements to the game world. We will continue to work with the community on today’s update to improve and polish the upcoming content ahead of the full Act 2 release and extend our thanks for the support and feedback on REMEDIUM’s Early Access launch so far and look forward to further collaboration throughout the development journey.

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with your journal, you must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, which must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

[h3]REMEDIUM Act 2 features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 2 will introduce three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
[*] Today’s update unveils the new Fort location along with new mutants and boss type - Despite their beast-like looks these mutants wear armor and use human weapons like clubs, spears and even mortars. They inhabit a ruined fortress nestled into the mountainside protected by a deadly new boss. Mutant types: Grunt, Pikeman, Gunner. Boss: Huntress. Two more locations (Mine and Abbey), mutant types and bosses, will complete Act 2 and be released soon.
[*] Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
[*] Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customize them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
[*] Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
[*] An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
[*] Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
[*] Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. [/list]

notes.title: New DLC, “Tome of Dimensions”
notes.content:
[h3]An exciting new DLC, “Tome of Dimensions” now available to purchase on Steam! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684600/Deck_of_Ashes__Tome_of_Dimensions/
Meet Sibyl the Dark Soul, a lonely but fearless fighter looking to bring her race back from extinction. A deadly sharpshooter, Sybil uses different arrowheads in her arsenal to deal critical hits. Resurrect fallen enemies to deal even more damage, or use Fear and Hysteria to disorient foes. Learn a new character's history, access over 100+ new cards, and battle newly arrived dangerous enemies. 

To celebrate the release of the add-on we have prepared a new atmospheric trailer:

[previewyoutube=LYn-EWWCbkw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]But that's not all! [/h1]

Now you can discuss deck tactics with your friends playing on consoles! After all, Deck of Ashes is now available on them as well: 
[h3]- [url=https://www.xbox.com/games/store/deck-of-ashes-complete-edition/9nxz4cjh27lf]Xbox[/url];
- [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10002575/]PlayStation[/url];
- [url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Deck-of-Ashes-Complete-Edition-2196154.html]Nintendo Switch[/url]. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/a3a1555a09ca077e5e524c51570a26c7c184a67d.jpg[/img]

We've also done a lot of work on fixing small bugs previously found in the game. 

Thanks for the wait, enjoy the game and DLC!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0007

tags.feature: • Added the glow effect for the Big Zombie and Golem;
• Added the character death counter;
• Improved response to attacks from various states of the character: bounce, blocks, somersaults, lifts;
• Added the ability to skip dialogues;
• Altars after activation now are lighter;
• The clarity of the image as a whole has increased;
• Added 12 animations of attacks with various weapons;
• Added save point after the Chalice of Fate;
• Redesigned control layout for the gamepad;
• Parameters' sizes of objects lying on the ground have been increased;
• Now the character does not die in a puddle and in the well;
• Expanded the save zone after meeting with the second necromancer.

tags.bug: • Fixed saving of custom graphics settings;
• Fixed the choice of the language of the introductory video at the first start;
• Fixed a bug with an invisible Gargoyle;
• Fixed disconnection of controls in the menu after falling from the first ledge;
• Fixed blinking light in the Ice Cave;
• Fixed transitions of animations of turns when lifting a character from the ground;
• Fixed a bug with not saving user control settings.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.0002
notes.content:
We heard you and have already prepared the first pack of fixes for the game!
First of all, the evil Necromancer now correctly "gives out" the scroll after defeating him. Now your walkthrough is completely safe 😊

Secondly, from now on you will not feel completely defenseless when a crowd of enemies threw you to the ground. The hero will not take damage until he gets to his feet!
Ice Spikes will no longer deal damage based on which part of your body you touch them. After the update, Ice Spikes will always remove the same amount of HP.
We also worked a little on the video insert "Chalice of Fate", in our humble opinion, now it looks much better!

Well, for sweetness: we managed to find and eliminate the error when, in the battle with the Demon, the hero could fall and lose control. Nothing will stop you from kicking his ass!

We continue to work on improving the game and a fresh update is coming soon. You asked for the ability to skip cutscenes before the boss battles - we are working on it! We also intend to exclude sudden turns of the character during movement and attempts to strike. Plus you will be able to assign the buttons to the controller. After all, demons will not return our souls to us until we bring the game to an ideal state ...

______________
Brief summary of patch 1.0002
1. Fixed a bug with the Scroll of the Necromancer. Now the scroll does not disappear after the death of the latter.
2. Fixed a bug with the inability to rise after falling in battle. Now the hero does not take damage until he gets to his feet.
3. Fixed a bug with damage from Ice Spikes. Now they inflict the same damage regardless of what the hero touched them with.
4. Improved quality of the "Chalice of Fate" video insert.
5. Fixed a rare bug, when in the battle with the Demon after the fall of the hero lost control.
________________________
In the upcoming patch you will find:
1. Skip rollers in front of bosses.
2. The character will not turn when moving forward and trying to strike.
3. It will be possible to assign gamepad buttons.
